scope: Additive optional-output compatibility only. Source, synthetic tests, development-only output schema, existing immutable verification and hash evidence reviewed. No final corpus/scores/predictions, APIs, model fitting, model changes or new package inference performed by reviewer.
checks: Compared replacement against both original readiness gates: registry, complete model inventory, current source/model hashes, bundle integrity, verified development corpus identity and provenance remain required.

Literal frozen predict_rows output dictionaries advertise the required four score/identity fields without score_probabilities; package word-count branch is inspected separately. Indirect or inconsistent return schemas refuse instead of guessing.

Development-only packaged probe supplies include_probabilities=True, verifies every model and positive step count, and agrees with source-declared optional fields. Networking and final data directories are denied.

The truthful unavailable probability flag is accepted only when advertisements, observed output schema and immutable verification report all agree. Advertised but missing probabilities and unexpected probability fields fail.
All six numeric parity/invariance sections, per-model coverage, finite errors, full-fit step counts, original filesystem/network denial evidence, CLI agreement and empty-input check remain required.
Current immutable verification has exact displayed and raw equality across all 14 models and 4,726 development steps. This is delivery parity, not new accuracy evidence.

Readiness publication remains exclusive via hard link, preserves status/sources/gate_bindings/artifacts, and binds compatibility amendment/review/capability. Existing runtime benchmark accepts the unchanged schema.
Frozen bundle, verification report, models, registry and original orchestration sources remain unchanged; future orchestration must explicitly call the reviewed additive validator.
limitations: The new one-passage schema probe is additional capability evidence, not a replacement for the existing full-corpus relocated filesystem/network-denied verification.
Probability fields are optional public outputs; internal item probabilities do not imply a public distribution or calibration claim.
